t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms change randomly between rounds. The person usually chose the gnome with the bigger hat.

vb_textbox.text: I found that the colours that yielded the best scores switched. At first, it was brown, yellow, orange and pink that gave me the higher scores. After a while they switch to giving lower scores though so then you have to choose the other colours. You can 'see' the switch as the scores start going down to 4, 3, 2, 1, 0. So keep switching between the groups of colours based on the most recent score.
